The variety of dosas they offer is impressive, from the classic masala dosa to unique specialties like cheese burst dosa and paneer dosa. Each dosa was generously filled and cooked to perfection. The dosa had the right balance of crispiness and tenderness, and the accompanying coconut chutney and sambar were the perfect complements.

What truly sets this place apart is the friendly and welcoming staff. They ensure that you have a pleasant dining experience, and their service adds an extra layer of warmth to the delicious food.

The prices are reasonable, making it accessible for all dosa lovers. Whether you're a dosa aficionado or trying it for the first time, this food stall in Thakur Village is a must-visit. I can't wait to return for more mouthwatering dosas!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Masta chamchamit is exactly like it’s name. Here you can taste the actual maharashtrian homemade seafood.

They are serving variety of fresh seafood; all prepped at their home. There might be slight change in menu day to day according to availability of the fish. Quality & Quantity of the food makes justice to the price.

Their service is also really good. Cleanliness has been maintained. So if you’re in Dadar/prabhadevi/ worali area let this be your next spot for all your seafood cravings.

featured_reviews.name: Kedar Tondwalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing coastal food experience at Masta Chamchamit. We tried the surmai fry, prawns masala, prawns fry, and bhakri, and every dish was spot on. The food was absolutely delicious, with A1 quality and generous portions. The surmai and prawns were clearly fresh, cooked perfectly, and full of authentic coastal flavors. The taste truly lived up to the name Masta Chamchamit.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of trying the offerings from this small setup food stall, and I must say, they are off to a fantastic start! The highlight for me was the crab curry—it was absolutely amazing. The flavors were rich, perfectly balanced, and the crab was cooked to perfection, making every bite a delight.

What makes this experience even more special is the homemade touch in every dish. The food feels fresh, comforting, and authentic, as if made with love in a family kitchen. The fish dishes were equally impressive, with fresh ingredients and well-balanced spices that made the flavors truly stand out.

If you’re looking for fresh, flavorful, homemade seafood, especially a standout crab curry, this is a startup worth supporting. I’ll definitely be coming back for more!
